How to use OCD Live

For Bovann and the Bovann Group team, for sellers of the OCD movement in Africa, Haiti and the diaspora, and for anyone who wants to see how a large TikTok account can become a stage for small businesses.

Open OCD Live ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to ocd-live-lemon.vercel.app. FR and EN at the top switch the language; the moon button switches to the dark theme.

2

Click Demo at the top for the 6-minute guided tour. Leave it at any time with the cross, Exit tour, a click outside or the Esc key.

3

Or log in as an entrepreneur with a phone number and the demo code 1234. The team space is reserved for Bovann Group, with personal logins.

4

On the Demo page, open an entrepreneur demo account or run a scenario.

5

Read the book from The book in the menu, chapter by chapter, or download the PDF.

02

Features

01

Book a live

The studio in Lomé or a remote live, a December calendar with the free slots of each day, lives of 1h30 and six packages. Two prices come from Bovann, 15,000 FCFA for a live and 40,000 FCFA for the week pack; the four others are proposals to confirm.

STEPS

  1. Open Live
  2. Choose the studio or a remote live
  3. Pick a day, a time and a package
  4. Fill in the business details and pay
02

Ticket and notification

The seller gets a ticket with a QR code and a list to prepare the live. Bovann Group receives the sentence Bovann asked for: who, what business, which day and from what time to what time, at the studio or remote.

STEPS

  1. Pay in the last step
  2. Read the ticket and the notification
  3. Ask the agent to prepare the live
03

Control room

The day's schedule, the notifications received, and the banner shown on the live with the seller's name, business, number and address. The day exports as a CSV file.

STEPS

  1. Log in with a Bovann Group team account
  2. Open Schedule and control room
  3. Pick a live to show its banner
04

Remote lives

The host in Lomé sees each remote seller with the country and local time, a checklist for the connection, and a reminder message ready to copy.

STEPS

  1. In the team space, open Remote lives
  2. Check the local time of each seller
  3. Tick the checklist and copy the reminder
05

Team space

A dashboard with lives booked, fill rate, revenue and notifications, then the sellers, the payments by method and the packages with their prices. Each role sees only what it needs.

STEPS

  1. Log in with the president's account
  2. Read the dashboard
  3. Change a price in Packages
06

Business tools

Sell with a payment link per product and follow the orders, write invoices and quotes in FCFA with a PDF and a WhatsApp reminder, and track expenses from a receipt photo.

STEPS

  1. Open Business
  2. Create an invoice or a quote
  3. Add an expense from a receipt
07

OCD Agent

Twelve skills added like apps, from Prepare my live to Who owes me money. The agent prepares and the seller decides; nothing leaves without approval and it never sees the mobile money PIN. Its mark is an open door with an arrow going out.

STEPS

  1. Open Agent
  2. Pick a skill
  3. Read what it prepares, then decide
08

My page

A public page for each seller: services and prices, hours, address, WhatsApp, the next live and a QR code to print.

STEPS

  1. Open My page
  2. Edit the details
  3. Share the link or print the QR code
09

Guided tour and demo accounts

The tour clicks through the real app, lights up each screen and explains it, to read or to hear. Demo accounts and scenarios open a seller's view in one click; the team chapters appear after a Bovann Group login.

STEPS

  1. Click Demo at the top
  2. Start the tour or pick a scenario
  3. Leave with the cross at any time
10

The book

Les opportunités c'est dehors, 304 pages in French: the OCD movement, the app screen by screen, its potential and the proposed partnership. Read in the app with its front and back covers, part pages and chapter openers drawn from nineteen African traditions, or as a PDF.

STEPS

  1. Open The book in the menu
  2. Start reading or pick a chapter
  3. Use A+ to enlarge the text
03Tips
  • Present with the guided tour first, then let the person try a scenario alone.
  • Reset the demo from the side menu before a presentation.
  • Everything runs in the browser: no real payment, no real account, nothing sent.
04FAQ
Is this an official Bovann Group service?

No. It is a proposal built in answer to Bovann's public request, with example data. Prices, payment providers and the launch date are to be confirmed with Bovann Group.

Which payments?

KPay for Cameroon: MTN MoMo, Orange Money and cards. Elsewhere, the country's operators through a local provider still to choose, and cards through KPay.

Can the agent send messages on its own?

No. It prepares and the seller decides. It never sees the mobile money PIN.

Where is the book?

Under The book in the menu, read in the app, or as a 304-page PDF.

Which languages?

French first, and English. The book is in French.
